Northern has been writing alone in his dorm. He wants to read one page to real neighbours, but the library's room record is lost among old labels. Help him find a place to begin.

journeys.help:
Help & privacy
Start a day

Walk west from the plaza to Hobbs Cafe and talk to Kevin. Or explore the library, grocery, park and noticeboard. You can ask questions, take work, decline or walk on.

Northern wants to share a favorite first page with his neighbors. Help find the library record he needs, then choose a small outdoor reading or a later gathering at the library. Read the project to choose a paid contribution or decline it.

Library project
Move and talk

Use WASD or arrow keys to walk. On a phone, hold a direction on the map. Go somewhere offers destination buttons and single-step directions. Press Enter beside a resident, click their sprite, or use Talk nearby.

The clock starts paused. You can walk while paused. Press 1× or 4× to move town time; Hour skips forward. Pause gives you time to read. A direction stops a destination walk.

Your choices

Read the terms in Choices before accepting bread, work or payment. Conversation alone cannot move your money or commit your time. Journal keeps agreements, recorded events and tabs; Inventory keeps carried items. A loaf can be eaten once and its tab is paid separately.

Dialogue & privacy
Use local dialogue only

Local dialogue works without a provider and sends no AI requests, including residents’ background conversations. It uses authored responses, so open-ended subjects are limited.

With AI enabled, your message, relevant memories, recent dialogue and resident profiles are sent to the game’s configured AI service to generate a reply. Replies can be mistaken. Recorded events and explicit choices determine what actually happened.

Dialogue preference saved in this browser.

Your saved town

The town saves in this browser. Download town keeps a portable backup; Import lets you restore the same people or create a separate town with copied histories. Both replace this browser’s current town after keeping a recovery copy. Downloads include conversation history and private resident notes. Keep backups somewhere private. There is no account-based cross-device sync yet.
